entry_state: Connected groups close at cash and equity 88.3, but different recognition histories reach that same endpoint. Each event must validate and publish complete measurements atomically; exact retry returns the original receipt without repeating accounting. PAA eligibility and claim measurement now require their own conditions.
exit_state: Coverage, service-to-premium timing and claim settlement are separate clocks. Acquisition-cost choice and claim-incurrence finance affect interim income despite equal final cash. Reinsurance and direct participation retain their own boundaries, eligibility and valuation inputs before guarantee pricing.
findings: One-year PAA eligibility does not permit ignoring a two-year claim discount. The example's LIC 55 differs from the incorrect undiscounted 65.5.
Deferred and immediately expensed acquisition costs reach the same total but different interim results. The onerous top-up is 16, not another full FCF liability of 70.
LIC finance uses the supplied claim-incurrence rate 10 percent rather than group-inception 5 percent. Final cash 259.6 and cumulative OCI zero reconcile the path.
Reinsurance recovery 45 under conditional 90 percent collectability leaves gross liability 100. Direct-participation eligibility is not inferred from a simple fee share. No new defect observed.
